outcome: Pregnancy complications (preeclampsia, pregnancy-induced hypertension, gestational diabetes)
cohort: 2,503 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies admitted to a maternity department in Tehran, Iran
finding: The study found a decrease in preterm births and low birth weight during the initial COVID-19 lockdown period compared to the pre-pandemic period, with no significant change in stillbirths or pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the mode of delivery observed between the pre-pandemic and pandemic periods.
